## Payments

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2/captures-refund): Refunds a captured payment, by ID. For a full refund, include an empty payload in the JSON request body.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2/authorizations-capture/): Captures an authorized payment, by ID.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2/authorizations-get/): Shows details for an authorized payment, by ID.
